授業科目の概要.科目名称: Special Lecture on Animal and Marine Science 1
授業科目の概要.曜日時限:
秋学期 火曜日 ３時限
秋学期 火曜日 ４時限

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 実験動物や家畜などの動物を用いた実験について、基礎的な知識や技術を学ぶ。そして、様々な動物の飼育環境等を実際に見学することで、動物科学の実践的な側面を体感し、その必要性についても理解する。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: Students will learn the basic knowledge and techniques involved in conducting experiments using animals such as laboratory animals and livestock. Furthermore, by visiting the actual housing facilities for various animals, students will gain firsthand experience with the practical aspects of animal science and come to understand its importance.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Cow, Mouse, SPF animal, Animal science
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件:
Lecture for 6/Oct:
Students have to keep all of the following rules and submit the declaration before the lecture via moodle (before 6/Oct);
・You do not keep rodents such as hamsters or mice, or rabbits, as pets.
・Do not use strong-smelling products such as hair products or perfume when entering the facility.
・At least 7 days have passed since your entry into or return from a foreign country.
・You have not entered any other animal testing (breeding) facility within the 2 days prior to your scheduled visit.
・You have not visited a zoo or pet store within the two days prior to your scheduled entry.
Lecture for 13, 20/Oct:
For biosecurity reasons, students who have visited another farm or livestock-related facility on the same day, or who have entered Japan from another country within the past two weeks, should not enter the sanitation control zone. Please also do not bring or use shoes or clothing that have been recently used overseas.
Lecture for 27/Oct:
Students have to keep all of the following rules and submit the declaration before the lecture via moodle (before 27/Oct);
・You do not keep birds such as parakeets, zebra finches etc., as pets.
・Do not use strong-smelling products such as hair products or perfume when entering the facility.
・At least 14 days have passed since your entry into or return from a foreign country.
・Clothes worn in the foreign countries are not brought into the facility without washing.
・You have not entered any other animal testing (breeding) facility, a zoo, or pet store within the same day prior to your scheduled visit.
